subject: Documentation of some Inla Internal Functions

messages.author: 118ad936abe03634
messages.subject: Documentation of some Inla Internal Functions
parts:
Hi all,
Is there any documentation of the functions: Inla.qsample, inla.spde2.precision, and other internal functions related to the creation of the Precision Matrix
Regards
Carlos

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Documentation of some Inla Internal Functions
parts:
Hi,

the underlying algorithm for inla.qsample is detailed in the Rue&Held
2005 GMRF book.
Apart from the node reorderings, a condensed document about the
involved methods is available here:
http://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/~flindgre/rinla/gmrf.pdf

For inla.spde2.precision, I've put a note on the internal
implementation/interface, that includes a link to the theory paper
(look there for what the building block matrices "M" are for the spde
models), here:
http://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/~flindgre/rinla/spde2_implementation.pdf

Finn
